DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この前、シャーレに新しく休憩室を作るから、畳が必要って言ってなかった？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、座敷の休憩室が欲しいって言われて……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: でも、急にどうしたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ今度、旧校舎来たときに持っていっていいよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 温泉郷の跡地を整理してたら、高級畳をたくさん見つけてさ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 特別クラスでは使わないの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うーん、畳って香りはいいんだけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 腐りやすいから、旧校舎にはあまり向かない気がするんだよね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: でも、このまま放置しておくのももったいないし……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 必要な人がいるならあげたほうがいいかなって

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それはありがたいけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 旧校舎の修理に必要な素材は足りてる？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん。温泉郷跡から資材は十分手に入ったから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 強いて言うなら……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 甘いお菓子、とかかな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 他の食材はその辺でいくらでも手に入るけど、お菓子はそうもいかないからね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、畳はお菓子と交換しよう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ、いいね。楽しみにしてる

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、また今度ね、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、地下水の水圧が変なんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 前に掃除してから何日も経ってるのに、湯船に水がほとんど溜まってなくて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この調子だと、あと一週間はかかっちゃうなぁ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: だったらお風呂はどうするの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うーん、仕方ないけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 前みたいに川で水浴びするしか……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: でも、風邪引いちゃうよ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 別の場所へ入りにいったら？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: どうかな……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いくら特別クラスの生徒でも

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 広場にある噴水のお湯で入浴してたら大騒ぎになると思うけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 「他のお風呂に行ったら？」って意味だよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この前フルーツ牛乳を作ってから、ずっと試してたんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: フルーツ牛乳は混ぜたばかりのものが一番おいしいと思うんだよね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 果物は香りや食感が変わりやすいから

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そうだね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それに牛乳も鮮度が落ちやすいから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: でも普通の温泉では、あらかじめ作ってあるフルーツ牛乳を売ってるんだよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: だから、一つ考えてみたんだけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 休憩室にフルーツ牛乳バーを置くのはどうかな。バーテンダーがいて、お客さんがお風呂から上がったらすぐにフルーツ牛乳をブレンディングしてくれるんだよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そうすればフルーツ牛乳を美味しいうちに飲んでもらえるし、お客さんの好みに合わせたブレンディングもできるでしょ？一度試してみる価値はあると思う

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 面白いアイデアだけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 温泉施設はフルーツ牛乳のためにそこまでするかな……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あ、それについては大丈夫

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あの銭湯に紹介してもらった温泉で、数日働かせてもらうことになったから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、結局風邪ひいたんだって？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さっきシャーレに用事があったから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 休憩室に生姜を入れたミルクティーを置いてきたよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 寒気がする時に温めて飲んでね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今の私にぴったりなブレンドだね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: わざわざ気を遣ってくれてありがとう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: だから私と一緒のお布団で寝ればいいって言ったのに

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日はあったかいお布団でぐっすり寝てね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……「発酵」に頼らずに

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……肝に銘じます

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、旧校舎の湯船にお湯が溜まったよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ついでに周りの環境整備をして、新しい入浴剤も入れておいた

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: よかったら先生も入りに来て

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 復旧できてよかったけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 「ぶどうジュース」は入ってないよね……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ、どうかな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 気になるなら、直接確認しに来たらどう？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 待ってるよ、先生

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 전에 샬레의 휴게실을 보수하는 데 다다미가 필요하다고 하지 않았었어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 응. 좌식 휴게실을 원하는 학생들이 몇 있어서……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그런 이야기를 한 것 같기는 한데…… 갑자기 왜?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 다음에 구교사에 올 때 다다미 좀 가져가.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 저번에 무너진 온천장을 정리하다가 창고에 쌓아 놨던 고급 다다미를 잔뜩 찾았거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 특별반에서 직접 쓰지 그래?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 음, 푹신하고 좋은 향이 나기는 하지만……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다다미 바닥은 썩기 쉬우니까. 구교사의 환경에는 그다지 적합하지 않은 것 같아서.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 하지만 이대로 방치해 두는 것도 아깝고……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이왕이면 필요한 곳에서 가져다 쓰는 편이 좋을 것 같아서.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 하지만 구교사의 물건을 가져다 쓰려니 어쩐지 미안한걸.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 구교사의 보수에 필요한 재료는 부족하지 않아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 괜찮아. 무너진 폐허에서 필요한 자재는 충분히 구할 수 있었거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그 밖에 아쉬운 점이라면……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 역시 입을 달래 줄 만한 간식 정도려나.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다른 식재료라면 야생에서도 얼마든지 구할 수 있는데, 달콤한 과자는 언제나 아쉽거든.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 다음에 기회가 되면 과자를 좀 사 갈게.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 후후, 기대하고 있겠어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 다음에 보자, 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 확실히 지하수의 수압이 예전 같지가 않네

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 저번에 청소를 한 뒤로 벌써 며칠이나 지났는데, 아직도 탕에 물이 거의 차지 않았어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 목욕을 할 수 있으려면 앞으로 1주일은 물을 더 받아야 할 것 같은데……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그동안 목욕이나 샤워는 어떻게 하려고?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭐, 귀찮지만 하는 수 없지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 전처럼 얼어붙은 강에서 냉수 목욕을 하는 수밖에

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 하지만 냉수 목욕은 건강에 좋지 않을 텐데……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 대신 다른 곳에서 목욕을 하는 건 어때?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 으음. 어떠려나……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아무리 정학 처분을 받은 특별반의 학생이라 하더라도

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 광장에 설치된 온수 분수대에서 목욕을 하면 큰 소동이 벌어질 텐데……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 다른 목욕탕에 가자는 뜻이었다고!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 지난번에 후르츠 밀크를 만든 뒤로 계속 시험해 봤는데

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다른 음료수와는 달리 후르츠 밀크는 갓 섞은 게 제일 맛있는 것 같더라고

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 우유에 섞인 과일은 향이나 식감이 변질되기 쉬우니까

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그렇긴 하지……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 게다가 우유는 상하기도 쉬우니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그런데 보통의 온천장에서는 미리 만들어 둔 후르츠 밀크를 팔잖아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 개선 아이디어를 하나 생각해 봤는데……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 휴게실 카운터에 바텐더가 상주하고 있다가 손님이 목욕을 하고 나오면 바로 후르츠 밀크를 블렌딩해 주는 거야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그럼 후르츠 밀크의 맛도 살릴 수 있고, 손님의 취향에 맞는 맞춤 서비스도 제공할 수 있겠지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 재미있는 생각이기는 하지만……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 우유 하나 때문에 일부러 종업원을 고용하는 온천장이 있을까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 목욕탕 사장님께 소개받은 다른 온천장에서

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 시험 삼아 며칠간 일해보기로 했어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: ……갑자기?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……선생님. 결국 감기에 걸렸다며?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아까 돌아가는 길에 잠깐 샬레에 들를 일이 있어서

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 휴게실에 생강과 홍차를 섞은 우유를 두고 왔어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 몸이 으슬으슬할 때마다 조금씩 데워서 마시도록 해

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 지금의 나에게 딱 맞는 우유 블렌딩이네……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 일부러 챙겨줘서 고마워.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러니까 처음부터 나랑 같이 이불을 덮고 잤으면 좋았을 텐데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘은 꼭 두꺼운 이불을 덮고 푹 자도록 해.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: ……술에는 의존하지 말고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: ……명심하겠습니다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 지난번에 청소한 구교사의 탕에 물을 다시 모두 채웠어

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그사이에 겸사겸사 주변 환경도 정리하고 새 입욕제도 넣어두었으니

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 나중에 괜찮다면 선생님도 한 번 목욕하러 와

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 탕이 복구되었다니 다행이지만……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 설마 또 와인을 넣은 건 아니겠지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 후후, 어떠려나

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 의심스러우면 구교사에 한 번 직접 와보는 건 어때?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 기다리고 있을게, 선생님.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Didn't you say that you needed some tatami mats for Schale's lounge?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Yup. A few of the students would like to be able to sit comfortably on the floor.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I think I mentioned it, but... Why do you ask?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Next time you visit the Former Institute, I'll have some tatami mats for you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I found a whole bunch of fine tatami in storage when we were cleaning up after the hot spring resort.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: The Spec Ops students don't want them?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well... They are pretty soft, and they smell nice, but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Tatami floors rot too easily. I don't think the Former Institute is a good place for them.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And just leaving them in storage is a waste...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I think it'd be better to give them to someone who'll actually use them.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I feel bad taking anything from the Former Institute.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Don't you need materials for your renovations and repairs?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's all right. We can find plenty of materials scavenging around the nearby ruins.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If there's anything we don't have enough of...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's snacks. Good ones to keep our mouths entertained.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: There's more than enough food if we forage in the wild, but sweets are always in short supply.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll bring some cookies next time I swing by.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee. I'm looking forward to it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: See you later, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The spring is taking a really long time to refill.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's already been a few days since we emptied it out, and there's hardly enough water to splash around in.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It'll be another week at least until we can take a hot bath...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: How are you going to keep clean in the meantime?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It'll be a pain, but there's no helping it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: We'll have to bathe in the frozen river like before.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Cold baths aren't good for you, you know...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Why not bathe somewhere else?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Mm. I wonder...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Even if they expect it from suspended students like us,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: it'll cause a scene if we try bathing in the heated fountains in the plaza...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I meant in another bath!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I've been experimenting with my fruit milk recipes.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The thing about fruit milk is that it's always most delicious right after it's mixed.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you leave it sitting too long, you start getting changes in the smell and texture.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I suppose so.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: And of course, there's also the danger of the milk spoiling.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But most hot spring resorts and bathhouses just sell drinks they got from a store, right?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So I had an idea...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What if there was a bartender in the lounge area, and whenever a customer finished their bath, the bartender mixed them up a fresh fruit milk on the spot?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That way, not only does the customer get the best fruit milk possible, but it's also tailor-made for their taste!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's an interesting idea, but...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Are there any hot spring resorts that would hire someone just for that?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The only way to know for sure is to try it out. So I'm doing an experiment.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The owner of the bathhouse in town set me up with a temporary job at another hot spring resort.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: ...Well that's pretty sudden.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei. I hear you caught a cold.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I had to stop by near Schale on my way home.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I left some ginger and milk tea for you in the lounge.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Please help yourself if you're feeling chilly.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You've picked out just the milk blend I need...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Thank you for taking care of me.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You should have just shared a futon with me like I asked.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Make sure to use extra thick blankets tonight.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Alcohol is not enough to keep you warm.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll keep that in mind...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, we finally managed to refill the bath.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I've tidied up the whole place and put in some bath bombs too.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'd love it if you came and had a bath here.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm glad to hear the bath is fixed...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You didn't use wine again, did you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee... I wonder.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you're suspicious, come and see for yourself.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll be waiting, Sensei.

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก่อนหน้านี้เคยบอกว่าอยากได้เสื่อ
ทาทามิไปใช้ในห้องพักผ่อนของ
ชาเล่ต์ใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
อื้ม มีนักเรียกหลายคนที่อยากได้
ห้องพักผ่อนแบบนั่งพื้นน่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูน่าจะเคยพูดไว้...มั้ง?
จู่ๆ ถามทำไมเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
งั้นคราวหน้าถ้ามาอาคารเรียนเก่า
ก็มาเอาเสื่อทาทามิไปด้วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ตอนเก็บกวาดบ่อออนเซ็นที่พัง
ฉันเจอเสื่อทาทามิในโกดังเพียบเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่เอาไปใช้ในห้องเรียนพิเศษเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม มันก็นุ่มและมีกลิ่นหอมดีหรอกนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่พื้นเสื่อทาทามิมันผุง่าย มันไม่น่า
จะเหมาะกับสภาพแวดล้อมของอาคาร
เรียนเก่าน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่จะให้ทิ้งไว้อย่างนี้ก็เสียของ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไหนๆ ก็ไหนๆ แล้ว ถ้าได้เอาไปใช้ใน
ที่ที่จำเป็นก็น่าจะดีกว่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าเอาของของอาคารเรียนเก่ามาใช้
ครูก็คงรู้สึกผิดอยู่นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
แล้ววัสดุที่ใช้บูรณะอาคารเรียนเก่า
จะพอใช้เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อื้ม ไม่เป็นไรหรอก พวกฉันหาวัสดุ
จำเป็นจากในซากที่ถล่มมาได้
เพียงพอแล้วน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ถ้าพูดถึงเรื่องของที่เรามีไม่พอ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็คงเป็นพวกของว่างที่เอาไว้กินฮีลใจ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าเป็นวัตถุดิบอาหารอย่างอื่น ฉันพอ
จะหาในป่าเอาได้ แต่ถ้าเป็นพวกขนมหวาน
ละก็...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
งั้นคราวหน้าถ้าแวะไป ครูจะเอาขนม
ไปให้นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮุฮุ แล้วฉันจะตั้งตารอนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นเอาไว้เจอกันใหม่นะคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แรงดันน้ำใต้ดินดูลดลงจากเดิมแฮะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
นี่ก็ผ่านไปหลายวันแล้วตั้งแต่ทำความ
สะอาดครั้งก่อน แต่น้ำในบ่อก็ยังไม่เต็มเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
กว่าจะลงไปอาบน้ำได้ คงต้องรอ
น้ำอีก 1 สัปดาห์แน่เลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แล้วระหว่างนั้นจะอาบน้ำกันยังไงล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็... ถึงจะไม่อยากทำ แต่ก็ช่วยไม่ได้น่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันคงต้องไปอาบน้ำเย็นๆ จากลำธาร
ที่เป็นน้ำแข็งเหมือนเดิม

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
แต่อาบน้ำเย็นขนาดนั้น
มันไม่ดีต่อสุขภาพนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไปอาบน้ำที่อื่นแทนไม่ดีกว่าเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม... เอายังไงดีนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถึงจะเป็นนักเรียนห้องเรียนพิเศษที่ถูก
ลงโทษพักการเรียนก็เถอะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ถ้าไปอาบน้ำในลานน้ำพุร้อนกลาง
จัตุรัส ก็คงจะวุ่นวายไม่น้อยแน่ๆ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูหมายถึงให้ไปโรงอาบน้ำที่อื่น
ต่างหากเล่า!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
หลังจากทำนมรสผลไม้ครั้งก่อน
ฉันก็ทดลองสูตรใหม่มาเรื่อยๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
จนมารู้ว่านมรสผลไม้ต่างกับเครื่องดื่ม
อื่นตรงที่มันจะอร่อยที่สุดตอนทำเสร็จใหม่ๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เพราะถ้าทิ้งไว้นานๆ กลิ่นและเนื้อ
สัมผัสของผลไม้ที่ผสมกับนม
จะเริ่มเปลี่ยนไปน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มันก็จริงนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แถมนมยังเสียง่ายอีก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ปกติแล้วในโรงอาบน้ำจะขายนมรส
ผลไม้ที่ทำเตรียมไว้ก่อนแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันก็เลยคิดหาไอเดียดีๆ ที่จะพัฒนา
เครื่องดื่มนี้ได้...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
นั่นก็คือให้บาร์เทนเดอร์ประจำอยู่ที่
เคาน์เตอร์ห้องพักผ่อน แล้วก็ผสมนมรส
ผลไม้ให้กับลูกค้าที่อาบน้ำออกมาน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าทำแบบนั้นนมรสผลไม้ก็จะยังอร่อย
อยู่ แล้วก็ยังเสิร์ฟนมรสผลไม้ให้ตรงกับ
ความชื่นชอบของลูกค้าได้ด้วย

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
มันก็ดูเป็นความคิดที่น่าสนใจอยู่
หรอกนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
แต่มีโรงอาบน้ำไหนจ้างพนักงาน
มาเสิร์ฟนมโดยเฉพาะด้วยเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก็นั่นแหละ ฉันก็เลยไปลองๆ ฝึกงานที่
โรงอาบน้ำอื่น

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ที่เจ้าของโรงอาบน้ำที่รู้จักแนะนำให้น่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ...กะทันหันมากเลยนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ...คุณครู ได้ยินว่าเป็นหวัดเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ระหว่างทางกลับเมื่อกี้ ฉันมีธุระต้อง
แวะไปที่ชาเล่ต์

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก็เลยเอานมรสขิงกับชาแดงไปวางไว้
ที่ห้องพักผ่อนให้แล้วนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เวลาหนาวๆ ก็อุ่นนมแล้วจิบทีละนิดนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
น่าจะเป็นนมที่เหมาะกับครู
ตอนนี้ที่สุดเลยละ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ขอบใจที่เอามาให้นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้ายอมนอนในผ้าห่มกับฉัน
ตั้งแต่แรก ก็คงไม่เป็นหวัดหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ก็นอนห่มผ้าหนาๆ ด้วยล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
...แล้วก็ไม่ต้องไปพึ่งพาเหล้าให้ร่าง
กายอบอุ่นหรอกนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ...น้อมรับคำสั่ง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู บ่อออนเซ็นของอาคารเรียนเก่า
ที่ทำความสะอาดไปคราวก่อน ตอนนี้
น้ำเต็มแล้วนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ระหว่างนั้นฉันเตรียมพื้นที่รอบๆ ไว้
แล้วก็ใส่บาธบอมบ์ใหม่ไว้ด้วยแล้วละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้ถ้าคุณครูมีเวลาก็แวะมาแช่น้ำได้นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: โล่งอกไปทีนะที่ซ่อมแซมบ่อได้แล้ว...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ได้ใส่ไวน์ลงไปในบ่ออีกใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮุฮุ ใส่ไปรึเปล่าน้า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าสงสัยก็ลองมาพิสูจน์เองกับตา
ที่อาคารเรียนเก่าสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วฉันจะรอนะคุณครู

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 你之前是不是有說過整修夏萊的休息室需要榻榻米？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，因為有幾個學生想要那種休息室……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 好像有說過……怎麼突然問這個？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那老師下次來舊校舍的時候可以拿一些榻榻米走哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 之前整理崩毀的溫泉浴場時，我找到很多積放在倉庫的高級榻榻米

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 特別班不留著用嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 唔嗯，雖然很鬆軟而且有香味……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 但是榻榻米很容易壞，感覺不太適合舊校舍的環境

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不過就這樣放著也很可惜……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 既然如此，我覺得給有需要的人使用比較好

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 拿舊校舍的東西來用，總覺得有點不好意思……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 整修舊校舍的材料不會不夠嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 沒關係。溫泉浴場留下的材料就已經很夠了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 要說還缺了什麼的話……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 像是是能解饞的零食，之類的吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 其他食材在這附近也能取得，但香甜的點心總是很缺

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 那下次有機會的話，我會買一些點心過去

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呵呵，我會期待的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼之後見囉，老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 地下水的水壓確實不如從前了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 上次打掃後已經過了幾天，但浴池的水卻幾乎積不起來

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 看這個情況，如果想洗澡可能還得要一個星期……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 那這段期間該怎麼洗澡呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 唔嗯，雖然麻煩，但也沒辦法……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 只能像之前一樣到結凍的河裡洗冷水澡了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 可是冷水澡對健康不好……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 到其他地方洗澡如何？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 唔嗯，這個嘛……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 就算是受到停學處分的特別班學生……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 要是到廣場上的熱水噴泉洗澡也會引起大騷動的吧……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我的意思是去其他澡堂！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 上次做了水果牛奶之後，我一直在做實驗

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 水果牛奶和其他飲料不同，在剛混合好的時候感覺是最好喝的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 因為混入牛奶中的水果香味和口感很容易變質

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這倒是真的……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 而且牛奶也很容易壞

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不過溫泉浴場賣的，一般不都是事先做好的水果牛奶嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以我想了一個改善方法……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那就是讓調酒師常駐休息室的吧檯，當客人洗完澡出來就馬上幫客人調製水果牛奶

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這麼一來不但可以保持水果牛奶的風味，也能提供適合客人愛好的客製化服務對吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這想法確實很有意思……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 但會有溫泉浴場只為了水果牛奶而特地雇用服務員嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以我決定在澡堂老闆介紹的其他溫泉浴場……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 工作幾天試試看

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……這麼突然？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……老師，結果你感冒了？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 剛才回去的路上有事路過了夏萊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我在休息室放了加入生薑和紅茶的奶茶哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 身體發冷的時候就熱一些來喝吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 這個牛奶特調正適合現在的我呢……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 謝謝你這麼為我著想

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以我才說要跟我一起蓋被子睡嘛

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天一定要蓋上暖暖的棉被好好睡一覺哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……還有別依賴酒精

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: ……我會銘記在心

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，我把之前打掃的舊校舍浴池重新裝滿水囉

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 還順便整理了周遭環境，加了新的入浴劑

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 之後老師有空的話也來洗澡吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 能修復真是太好了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 但你該不會又加了紅酒進去吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 呵呵，誰知道呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果想知道的話，要不要親自來一趟舊校舍？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我等你唷，老師
